abd-bing-1.webp.zh: 阿巴丹国际机场入口处的标识牌：波斯语与英文并排写着「阿亚图拉贾米国际机场」。
abd-bing-1.webp.en: The entrance sign at Abadan International Airport — Persian and English side by side, both reading 'Ayatollah Jami International Airport'.

abd-bing-3.webp.zh: 航站楼入口：旅客推着行李走向大厅，门楣上是红色招牌，外面的人行道铺着彩色地砖。
abd-bing-3.webp.en: The terminal entrance: travellers wheeling luggage towards the hall under the red-lettered sign, on a walkway paved with patterned tiles.
